My dear [Pixie](/person/539)
[Goosedom](/topic/104) will be very glad of Miss [Agnes Acland](/person/45).[^1] I believe I first missed seeing her at Oxford but I have often heard of her. I enclose a sheet of rules, and will tell [Double Daisy](/person/1161) to send her the questions.
your faithful
Mother Goose
Tell Miss Acland to choose her Gosling name


[^1]: Agnes Henrietta Acland (b.1851) who seems to have become a Gosling as Acorn, was the daughter of Sir Thomas Dyke Acland (1809–1898), 11th Bt., a prominent Tractarian layman with a special interest in education.
